current_suggestion.pitch: You already follow Renaissance Periodization as a channel, but Mike Israetel's personal channel publishes solo deep-dives and debates specifically on diet science — including pointed critiques of carnivore and low-carb claims with actual mechanistic and epidemiological counter-arguments — that the main RP channel doesn't cover. This steelmans the conventional/evidence-based side of the diet wars you're watching play out on Chaffee, Saladino, and Norwitz, giving you the strongest opposing case rather than a strawman. Format is usually direct-to-camera monologue or structured debate, dense and fast, with citations.
